why: Why Move to Fontainebleau shows done

notes.text: That milestone is gated on the 'Book flight to Paris for 3 January' task, and you marked that task Done last night (20:44 on 3 Oct). The milestone counts as reached whenever its gate task is done, so it flipped. It is really showing 'flight booked', not 'moved', which is misleading, since the 3 Jan date is still three months away. If the flight is booked, nothing is wrong with your data. I have not changed anything. The fix is in the board's code (gate the milestone on something that happens at arrival, or relabel it), so I'd do that on a branch rather than from this workflow.
acted: No board changes: the flight task being Done is what ticks the milestone
